REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Receipt accounting does not enforce unavailable propagation for all required raw telemetry. Token counters are reconciled, but provider cost and elapsed time are omitted, allowing accepted receipts to silently replace unknown cost with zero or report inconsistent elapsed totals.
FINDING: high|scripts/factory-ng-receipt-validate.py|Validation reconciles only token fields, not provider_cost_usd or elapsed_ms|This violates the contract that unknown telemetry remains unavailable and aggregates reconcile every per-call raw counter.
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Reconcile provider_cost_usd and elapsed_ms across model_calls using the same unavailable-propagation rule; add failing fixtures for unavailable per-call cost aggregated as zero and mismatched elapsed totals.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: One model call reports provider_cost_usd={"availability":"unavailable","reason":"not reported"} while aggregate telemetry.provider_cost_usd=0; the current schema and relationship validator accept it.
